Scene:
四年后，孟子开始帮妈妈祭拜。他画画很厉害，他越来越喜欢祭拜，所以他祭拜不是想帮妈妈工作，而是他很喜欢画画。孟子成为很著名的古代画家。今天很多中国人很喜欢孟子。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 他画画很厉害，他越来越喜欢祭拜：delete the second他，redundant; no logic relationship, add也before越来越
- 孟子成为很著名的古代画家：wrong information, 哲学家

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: Coherence (Reference): 而是他很喜欢画画：而是很喜欢画画，The subject has not changed within the paired clause, so Chinese normally uses the zero form instead of repeating the pronoun. [rule: none]
Run 2: 不是想帮妈妈工作，而是他很喜欢画画：不是为了帮妈妈工作，而是因为喜欢画画，The two halves of this contrast should give parallel reasons for the action; use “不是为了……，而是因为……” here, and omit the repeated subject in the second half. [teacher rule: bushi_ershi]
Run 3: Coherence (Reference): 而是他很喜欢画画：而是很喜欢画画，The contrasting clause still has the same subject, so zero form is more natural than another pronoun. [rule: none]

output.reason: Runs 1 and 3 only remove a redundant repeated subject, while Run 2 also rewrites the contrast into a purpose-versus-reason structure.
